pokemon-world-championships-2026-san-fra.summary: This San Francisco-only in-person event features a Stamp Rally, landmark-themed raids, and city scavenger-hunt research. Each Special Raid Location can be completed once per day and guarantees a Location Background on the caught Pokémon.
bonuses: :pokestop: The Stamp Rally awards up to six encounters with Pikachu wearing a Cosmog spacesuit and a Location Background
:raid: Catches from the seven Special Raid Locations are guaranteed to have a Location Background
Branching Timed Research offers 300 Mega Energy for the selected path

sections.title: In-person activities
items: 1-Star landmark raids: Fuecoco and Zigzagoon
3-Star landmark raids: Dewgong, Kingler, Alolan Exeggutor, and Duraludon
5-Star landmark raids: Rayquaza
City scavenger-hunt Timed Research awards 2026 World Championships Pikachu, Stardust, XP, and the red 2026 Worlds Tee

pokemon-world-championships-2026-timed-r.name: 2026 Pokémon World Championships Twitch Drops Timed Research
pokemon-world-championships-2026-timed-r.heading: Research
pokemon-world-championships-2026-timed-r.summary: Watch the official 2026 World Championships and Pokémon XP broadcasts to receive Timed Research for team building, the World Champion’s team, and two costumed Pikachu. Each redemption code must be used by September 11 at 20:00 UTC.
bonuses: Watch for 30 minutes: Great League team-building Timed Research
Watch for 60 minutes: 2025 World Champion’s team Timed Research featuring Tinkaton, plus an Elite Charged TM
Watch an official co-stream for 45 minutes: 2026 World Championships Pikachu Timed Research
Watch the Pokémon XP feature for 30 minutes: Pikachu wearing a Cosmog spacesuit Timed Research

sections.title: How to claim
items: Link your Pokémon Trainer Club account to your Twitch account
After meeting the watch threshold on the corresponding channel, claim the reward from your Twitch Drops Inventory
Visit rewards.pokemon.com to obtain a one-time redemption code, then use it on the Pokémon GO offer redemption page

mega-ascension.name: Mega Ascension
mega-ascension.heading: Event
mega-ascension.summary: This lead-up event for Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale centers on daily rotating Mega Raids, wild encounters, and branching Timed Research. Each day from August 31 through September 4 has a different Mega Raid Boss pool, while Mega Latias and Mega Latios may appear throughout.
bonuses: :raid: Daily Remote Raid limit increased to 30
:raid: Pokémon caught from Mega Raids may have a Mega Evolution–themed Special Background
Branching Timed Research lets you choose Chespin, Fennekin, or Froakie as your partner
GO Pass: Mega Finale becomes available on August 31, with its path determined by your chosen partner

sections.title: Mega Raid schedule
items: August 31: Mega Victreebel, Mega Dragonite, and Mega Malamar
September 1: Mega Falinks
September 2: Mega Skarmory
September 3: Mega Starmie
September 4: Mega Raichu X and Mega Raichu Y
Mega Latias and Mega Latios are also available throughout the event

sections.title: GO Pass note
sections.body: The free track awards encounters with your chosen partner, Candy, Link Charges, and enough Mega Energy for one corresponding Mega Evolution. The Deluxe track adds boosted Shiny odds, bonus Candy, Candy XL, and XP from Mega Raids, plus more Mega Energy.

pokemon-go-fest-2026-mega-finale.name: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale
pokemon-go-fest-2026-mega-finale.heading: Pokémon GO Fest
pokemon-go-fest-2026-mega-finale.summary: This free global event closes Pokémon GO Fest 2026 with eight hourly rotating habitats and extensive Mega Raids. Mega Mewtwo X headlines September 5 and Mega Mewtwo Y headlines September 6, with a complete habitat Mega Raid pool on each day.
bonuses: :raid: Unlimited Remote Raids on September 5–6
All Mega-Evolved Pokémon receive an extra CP boost during the event
:raid: Pokémon caught from Mega Raids may have a Mega Evolution–themed Special Background
The Deluxe GO Pass increases Shiny odds for certain Mega Raid and event encounters

sections.title: New Mega Evolutions
sections.body: During the lead-up and main-event weekend, progress along your chosen partner’s path to ultimately Mega Evolve it into Mega Chesnaught, Mega Delphox, or Mega Greninja.

sections.title: September 5 Full Mega Raid Pool
items: Verdant Overgrowth: Mega Beedrill, Mega Victreebel, Mega Pinsir, and Mega Abomasnow
Mindworks Canal: Mega Alakazam, Mega Slowbro, Mega Starmie, and Mega Medicham
Eerie Alley: Mega Gengar, Mega Houndoom, Mega Banette, and Mega Malamar
Circuit Plaza: Mega Raichu X, Mega Ampharos, and Mega Manectric
Super Mega Mewtwo X Raids appear all day at select Gyms

sections.title: September 6 Full Mega Raid Pool
items: Iron Frostworks: Mega Steelix, Mega Skarmory, Mega Aggron, and Mega Glalie
Battle District: Mega Sharpedo, Mega Camerupt, Mega Lopunny, and Mega Falinks
Skyline Roosts: Mega Gyarados, Mega Aerodactyl, Mega Dragonite, and Mega Altaria
Prism Promenade: Mega Raichu Y, Mega Sableye, Mega Mawile, and Mega Audino
Super Mega Mewtwo Y Raids appear all day at select Gyms

sections.title: Habitats and Raids
sections.body: Each day has four hourly habitats, and every habitat rotates in twice during the 10:00–18:00 event window. Regular Mega Raids change with the active habitat, while Mega Mewtwo appears only at select Gyms.
